name: VisualMRC: Machine Reading Comprehension on Document Images
description: VisualMRC is a machine reading comprehension benchmark requiring multimodal models to answer open-ended questions based on document screenshots. Extracted from 10,197 diverse webpage documents across 34 domains, it contains 30,562 question-answer pairs annotated with bounding-box grounded evidence regions, evaluating multimodal comprehension of web layouts, typography, charts, and contextual text.
